submission.natural_language_explanation: Retrospective detector for a word/segment onset: it fires on tokens that begin a new word at a boundary, strongest on the first token of the sequence (marked starters like Please/Our/For highest, default The at a ~0.78 floor) and weaker on later word onsets (next, Se, 1, space before 11), and stays near-silent on subword continuations (ine, 0, year). Its output direction suppresses code-related 'program' tokens.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Notwithstanding the cartographers’ initial reluctance, the highland survey proceeded through sleet and fog across eleven crooked valleys. Surveyors catalogued granite outcrops, peat bogs, juniper thickets, abandoned shepherd huts, and glacial tarns whose waters mirrored the overcast sky. Each evening the crew compared theodolites, recalibrated compasses, transcribed field notebooks, and debated routes over barley stew. Quartermasters rationed candles, dried mutton, oatcakes, rope, pitons, and waterproof charts. Messengers carried dispatches down switchback trails to the lowland depot, returning with salt, kerosene, newsprint, and letters from relatives. The expedition’s botanist pressed ferns, mosses, lichens, saxifrage, and alpine cushion plants between blotting sheets. Ornithologists logged ptarmigan, golden eagles, ravens, dotterels, and snow buntings circling the crags. Geologists chipped samples of gneiss, schist, quartzite, basalt dikes, and limestone pavements for later assay. Meteorologists released pilot balloons, emptied rain gauges, polished barometers, and chased runaway anemometers down scree slopes. Photographers developed glass plates in a tent darkroom reeking of fixer and collodion. Cooks foraged sorrel, chanterelles, juniper berries, and wild thyme to stretch the dwindling provisions. Farriers reshod the mules, stitched harness leather, and poulticed a mare’s split hoof. The chaplain read aloud from tattered volumes while darning socks by lantern light. When avalanches sealed the northern col, sappers blasted cornices, probed drifts with avalanche rods, and relayed survivors on rope litters. Draftsmen inked contour lines, hatched cliffs, tinted glaciers azure, and lettered peaks after patrons, pioneers, and local legends. Auditors tallied wages, fodder, dynamite, photographic chemicals, and postage in ledgers bound with brass clasps. Delegations from highland villages arrived bearing cheese, smoked trout, woolens, carved walking sticks, and petitions about grazing boundaries. Negotiators heard grievances, sketched compromises, witnessed marks, and sealed agreements with wax stamps. Winter descended early that year, glazing waterfalls, riming guy-ropes, and frosting the inside of every tent. Ice crystals feathered across instrument lenses, boot leather stiffened, ink froze in its wells, and breath hung motionless in the lamplight. Still the triangulation advanced ridge by ridge until the final baseline was chained across the frozen mere, closing the survey within a hairsbreadth of exactness.
